fields: h, intro, cols [part, like-for-like, change, what follows], rows, fold, fold_noun. kit (optional): one drawing name per row (membrane, probe, card, seal, edi, lamp, cartridge); without it the drawing is matched from the part's name, and a part with no match gets a plain pocket. Desktop shows the whole tray; the fold applies on phones, where the pockets stack one per row, drawing beside the answers.
best_for: SparesKit reads like-for-like rules off the spares kit: a tray (a shadow board seen from above) with one pocket per part, each part drawn flat in line art in its cut-out, and under it the answers: "=" like for like when, "≠" a change when, "→" what follows a change.
